market._comment: Montreal is a bilingual market — ad copy, landing pages, and lead follow-up should exist in both FR and EN. Owner contact: Pedro.

services._comment: Sanding/polishing/varnishing (refinishing) is the core money-maker and should be the focus of ad spend. The rest are real services but secondary — do not split budget across all of them at this stage.

unitEconomics._comment: Baseline from Pedro as of 2026-08-24, using a 600 sq ft reference job. jobCostPerSqFt is DIRECT job cost only — it does not include overhead (van, insurance, admin, ad spend) and may not fully cost the owner's own labour on overflow jobs. Treat grossMarginPct as gross-on-direct-cost, not net profit. See notes in the PR before using these for pricing decisions.

capacity._comment: CURRENT ceiling, not the target — the stated goal is to grow fleet and headcount, funded out of profit as leads convert. Ad budget should be paced against this, not against ambition: over-generating leads past servicing capacity burns spend and damages response times. Revisit dailyBudgetCap whenever headcount/vans change.
capacity.overflowBridge: Pedro + contractor personally take overflow jobs — temporary buffer during hiring gaps, not standing capacity.

ghl._comment: Real IDs read back from the live location. NOTE: this GHL location is shared with Pedro's older real-estate work — it also contains real-estate pipelines, real-estate custom fields, and ~169 legacy real-estate contacts that are NOT floor customers. Only the 'Matama Floors' pipeline above is relevant to this client. Stage display names in GHL are New Lead / Contacted / Proposal Sent / Scheduled / Closed / Lost; 'quoted' maps to Proposal Sent and 'completed' maps to Closed.

meta._comment: specialAdCategories is deliberately EMPTY. Meta's HOUSING restricted category covers listings, sales/rentals, mortgages and homeowners insurance — NOT home-improvement contractors selling a service. So unlike the real-estate client, Matama keeps full targeting: radius targeting under 15mi/25km, age and gender targeting, and lookalike audiences are all permitted. Do not copy HOUSING over from the real-estate config.

forge._comment: STARTING VALUES, not validated. cplThreshold is derived from job economics (~10% of the $1,700 reference gross profit spent per closed job, at an assumed ~25% lead->job close rate). The close rate is a GUESS until real data exists — revisit after the first ~30 leads. dailyBudgetCap is intentionally low and paced to the 1-van capacity above, not to what the funnel could spend.
forge.roasTargetComment: ROAS is meaningful here only because job value is large ($2,100 reference). A real-estate-style 3.5x target would never trigger and would be useless as a guardrail. Requires deal_value to be recorded on won opportunities in GHL — otherwise ROAS stays null and this rule never fires.

qualification._comment: Replaces the real-estate buy/sell script. These map directly to the inputs a pricing quote needs, so a qualified lead arrives quote-ready.
questions: Which service do you need — floor refinishing (sanding/polishing/varnishing), or an installation?
What kind of floor is it, and what condition is it in?
Is it a house, condo, or commercial space?
Is the space occupied or empty right now?
